purpose: Localize the valid V19DM2 Bullet integrated-spectrum failure without changing the thermal model, statistic, parameter bounds, data, gravity formula, or any source/lensing outcome.

diagnostic_bands.interpretation: sensitivity to the softest response and background regime
source-dominated continuum and Fe-K behavior without the soft complex
soft-band background, calibration, absorption and line-complex adequacy

interpretation_rules.broad_band_failure: Both frozen soft-only and hard-only fits exceed 1.5.
interpretation_rules.soft_localized: The 0.5-2 fit fails while the 1-7 fit passes.
interpretation_rules.hard_persistent: The 2-7 fit fails whether or not the soft band does.
interpretation_rules.no_authorization: Every result is diagnostic. No band-selected fit may authorize regional production or define the source.

claim_boundary: V19DN diagnoses spectral-model support only; it does not select a gravity formula or source invariant.
Energy bands and the 1.5 adequacy threshold are frozen before the band outcomes are opened.
No additional thermal component, systematic error, background scaling, or energy exclusion is admitted into production.
No I4, I5, lensing, halo, action, gravity parameter or holdout payload is opened.
